expectations.text: Avoids commodity language and vendor positioning
expectations.evidence: Uses defensive commodity language: 'professional assets', 'quality & realism', 'architectural accuracy', 'photorealism standards'; compares studios on quality/process, typical vendor defensiveness.

expectations.text: Connects to business outcome (sales, decisions, risk, alignment)
expectations.evidence: No outcome connection; discusses deliverables and process ('Design collaboration', 'Revisions & iteration', 'File deliverables'); doesn't connect visualization to client's actual business objective.

expectations.text: Positions Rendimension as strategic partner, not vendor
expectations.evidence: Positions as premium vendor with better quality; defends against price comparison; explains why Rendimension is different on quality/reliability grounds; stays in vendor comparison mode throughout.
Structure is quality-and-process-first; discusses 'Quality & Realism', 'Process & Communication', 'Experience & Expertise'; never frames around client outcomes or business objectives.

expectations.text: Would pass Hugo's review without edits
expectations.evidence: Would fail Hugo's review; negotiates on price/quality grounds instead of reframing; doesn't shift conversation to client's actual need; reads as typical quality defense, not strategic repositioning.
